description: Chat agent benchmark suite – 10 test cases progressing from simple to complex. Covers: vendor discovery (VALID_NEW_QUERY), follow-up from history (VALID_FOLLOWUP), out-of-domain routing (INVALID), educational/comparison queries, context carry-forward, multi-turn conversations, and edge cases. Tests the single-LLM combined classification: VALID_NEW_QUERY → MongoDB RAG, VALID_FOLLOWUP → history only, INVALID → router.

test_cases.name: Simple – Vendor Discovery, Pressure Transmitters (No History)
test_cases.description: Fresh query with no conversation history. Expects VALID_NEW_QUERY classification, triggering a MongoDB RAG search to return vendors offering pressure transmitters.

input.user_query: Which vendors make pressure transmitters suitable for oil and gas applications?

test_cases.name: Simple – Detailed Follow-up on Vendor
test_cases.description: The user asks about ABB specifically, but requests 'more about' them and their 'product range'. While ABB was mentioned in history, the specific product range details were not provided, thus requiring a VALID_NEW_QUERY (new DB/LLM search).

input.user_query: Can you tell me more about ABB and their pressure transmitter product range?

conversation_history.content: The main vendors for industrial pressure transmitters include: ABB, Emerson Rosemount, Endress+Hauser, Yokogawa, and Siemens.

test_cases.name: Simple – Invalid Query, Out of Domain
test_cases.description: Completely non-industrial query. Must be classified INVALID and routed appropriately. Validates the INVALID branch of the classification pipeline.

input.user_query: What is the best restaurant in Paris for a business dinner?

test_cases.name: Medium – Educational Comparison Query
test_cases.description: Conceptual question comparing two pressure measurement types. Even if pressure was discussed before, this requires LLM/DB knowledge for an educational answer. Must be VALID_NEW_QUERY.

input.user_query: What is the technical difference between differential pressure transmitters and absolute pressure transmitters? When would I choose one over the other?

test_cases.name: Medium – Context Carry-Forward to Different Product Type
test_cases.description: After a pressure transmitter conversation, user asks about 'temperature' without saying the product type. Context carry-forward must infer 'temperature transmitter' not just 'temperature'. This is a DIFFERENT product type not in history, so VALID_NEW_QUERY.

input.user_query: What about temperature? Which vendors offer good options?

conversation_history.content: Key vendors for pressure transmitters: ABB (266 series), Emerson Rosemount (3051), Endress+Hauser (Cerabar), Yokogawa (EJA). All support HART and 4-20mA output.

test_cases.name: Medium – Follow-up Requesting Specific Models (Not in History)
test_cases.description: History has vendor names only. User asks for specific models. The specific model data is NOT in history, so this must be VALID_NEW_QUERY (not VALID_FOLLOWUP), even though ABB and Emerson were mentioned.

input.user_query: Can you list the specific models that ABB and Emerson offer for pressure transmitters?

conversation_history.content: The main vendors for pressure transmitters are ABB and Emerson. Both are widely used in the process industry.

test_cases.name: Medium – Follow-up Comparison of Vendors in History
test_cases.description: History contains both vendor names AND their key specs/strengths from a previous detailed answer. User asks to compare them – the comparison data exists in history, so VALID_FOLLOWUP.

input.user_query: Based on what you told me, which one would you recommend between ABB and Emerson for offshore applications?

conversation_history.content: Tell me about ABB and Emerson pressure transmitters

ABB 266 Series: Known for robust construction, ideal for harsh oil & gas environments, SIL 2 rated, excellent long-term stability, wide pressure range up to 700 bar. Emerson Rosemount 3051: Market leader for process industries, superb accuracy (0.04%), excellent HART and Foundation Fieldbus support, strong track record in offshore platforms, SIL 2 certified for safety applications.

test_cases.name: Medium-Complex – Flow Meters Vendor Discovery (No History)
test_cases.description: Vendor discovery for flow meters in a specific application (cryogenic service). No history. Tests that the RAG pipeline correctly queries for cryogenic flow meter vendors.

input.user_query: Which vendors offer cryogenic flow meters suitable for LNG service? I need options for DN100 pipes at -165°C.

test_cases.name: Complex – Invalid: Solution Page Query Disguised as Chat
test_cases.description: User pastes a detailed instrument specification request that belongs on the Solution page, not the Chat page. Must be classified INVALID and routed to the solution/search page.

input.user_query: I need 3 pressure transmitters for crude oil service, 0-400 bar range, ATEX Zone 1, 4-20mA HART output, SIL 2 certified. Please select the best instruments for me.

test_cases.name: Complex – Multi-Turn Follow-up with Mixed History
test_cases.description: Multi-turn conversation with rich history covering both pressure and temperature transmitters with vendor details. User asks a follow-up about a general concept (response time) for instruments already discussed in detail. Data is in history → VALID_FOLLOWUP.

input.user_query: Out of the instruments you mentioned, which ones have the fastest response time?

conversation_history.content: What pressure and temperature transmitter vendors do you recommend for a petrochemical plant?

For a petrochemical plant I recommend: Pressure – ABB 266GST (gauge, 500ms response, SIL 2), Emerson 3051S (250ms response, highest accuracy, SIL 2). Temperature – Endress+Hauser TMT82 (300ms response, dual-compartment, SIL 2), Yokogawa YTA510 (400ms response, multi-input). Both pressure and temperature options support HART and Foundation Fieldbus.
Tell me more about the SIL 2 certifications for these

All four instruments carry IEC 61508 SIL 2 certification: ABB 266GST – TÜV certified SIL 2 for use in safety instrumented systems. Emerson 3051S – IEC 61511 compliant, SIL 2 capable without additional voting. Endress+Hauser TMT82 – SIL 2 per IEC 61508, dual-sensor option for SIL 3. Yokogawa YTA510 – SIL 2 certified, suitable for safety loops in shutdown systems.
